b: Only after getting on the bus did I sleep a little peacefully.. Now we had to go to a place called Ha Long Bay.. It's a cluster of islands in the Vietnamese sea.. You travel there by ship. For two days, food and lodging are all on the ship

I slept from all the tiredness.. When I woke, they'd stopped at a shop and sent us in. Since lots of people like us had come, our bus driver hung a card on us, like the ones they hang on first-year kids, so he could recognise us.. But even without it we stood out.. While everyone else who'd come was in nice clothes and shoes, there stood the five of us, unbathed, faces dripping with oil, looking a sight.. But not caring at all, we went round inside, and everything was terribly expensive.. Who's going to buy this, we said, and went back to the bus.No one came near us .. Thushara wondered whether some smell had started coming from us.. Since all five of us were in the same state, we couldn't smell anything

Finally the bus came and stopped at a harbour.. Since it's international waters, apparently you have to go through the harbour formalities.. As soon as our bus arrived, our ship's manager came.. He said his name was Tom Cruise.. He spoke reasonably good English.. But we only understood half.. He called out our names at once and took us in.. Our bags and bedding were all taken separately.

People had come from lots of countries like us.. He introduced everyone, the Thomas family from Italy, and so on; unable to read our names, he said one two three from Sri Lanka.. Glad he didn't kill our names struggling to read them

From there he put us in a small boat and took us.. It took us and left us on the big ship.. I'd never been on a ship in my life.. I went into the ship gawking happily.. The people with me seemed like they go on ships every day.. They behaved a bit properly

As soon as we went in, they gave us juice to drink in little cups..I didn't even know what it was… When we'd finished they told us to go up to the dining room… There they'd set a table for the five of us with our lion flag.. I felt very proud…. They'd put flags like this for the other countries' people too… It was a worry to think our country's honour was in our hands

That Tom Cruise came and introduced everyone and explained what there was to do on the ship.. He told us to go to our rooms quickly, bathe and get ready… We went to the room at once and our bags and bedding had come too
While I was gawking around, another bag of mine got left behind on that boat.. Luckily I talked to Tom and got that back too

It was a big, beautiful room.. Inside it another little room.. They'd put three beds in there.. So we decided the boys would sleep there.. But more than that, we were terribly hungry… While Thushara went to bathe, we all went up to eat
